## Goal

Create a column, summarise by group, reshape both ways, and join two tables.

## Transform and summarise

```{r transform}
library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
enroll <- read_csv("enrollment.csv")

enroll <- enroll |>
  mutate(gpa = na_if(gpa, 999)) |>                    # mark the 999 code as missing.
  mutate(gpa_group = case_when(
    is.na(gpa) ~ NA_character_,                        # missing gpa stays missing.
    gpa >= 3.5 ~ "High",
    gpa >= 3.0 ~ "Middle",
    TRUE ~ "Low"))

enroll |> group_by(program) |>
  summarise(across(c(gpa, credits), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) #average both columns.
```


```{r reshape-join}
scores <- read_csv("scores_wide.csv")
long <- pivot_longer(scores, c(midterm, final, project),
                     names_to = "score_type", values_to = "score")
wide <- pivot_wider(long, names_from = score_type, values_from = score)

advisors <- read_csv("advisors.csv")
joined <- left_join(enroll, advisors, by = "advisor_id")
head(joined)
```

## Bonus: students with no matching advisor

```{r bonus}
joined |> filter(is.na(advisor_name)) |> nrow()   # expect 0: every student matched an advisor.
```
